verdict.rationale: Phoenix has an SDK/API reference section covering zero-config tracing, tracing decorators, span querying and modular Python packages, and its docs are served as Mintlify markdown. Nothing shows that reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in-browser, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard arize.com paths. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it API explorer, runnable in-docs examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
